title: unified-rollouts: multi-metric quorum autorollback for canary + shadow
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Add multi-metric quorum-based automatic rollback for unified rollouts (canary + shadow). Improves safety of automated rollouts by requiring quorum on multiple telemetry categories before triggering rollback. Includes observability, e2e tests, and migration notes.
description: Motivation: current autorollback uses single-metric thresholds which can trigger noisy or false-positive rollbacks during transient load or metric noise. This change implements a configurable multi-metric quorum policy for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) so rollbacks are only executed when a configurable quorum of independent metrics cross severity thresholds. Summary: 1) Adds a MultiMetricQuorum policy type that accepts a list of metrics (latency_p50, latency_p95, error_rate, token_reject_rate, quality_regression_score) each with severity thresholds and weight; 2) Implements evaluation engine in rollouts service that computes per-metric violation windows, applies cooldowns, and evaluates quorum with quorum_size and optional quorum_strategy (majority|weighted); 3) Integrates the policy with canary and shadow workflows, ensuring shadow-only probes can contribute to quorum without affecting traffic routing until quorum is met; 4) Adds TTL-based quarantine stage for transient violations and manual override endpoints; 5) Exposes new observability metrics and tracing spans for quorum evaluations and decision provenance; 6) Adds e2e and unit tests plus performance bench to validate low-latency evaluation under typical canary loads. Checklist: [x] design doc and Linear tasks linked (ENG-4021, ENG-4178); [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests; [x] e2e stability harness; [x] perf bench; [x] docs and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: existing single-metric policies keep current semantics; multi-metric policy is opt-in. Rollout plan: land behind feature flag rollout.multimetric_quorum; enable for internal canaries for 2 weeks; enable for 10% of customer canaries for 1 week; ramp to 100% with monitoring. Related: pr-318002, pr-331213 for observability; ENG-4021 for product requirements.

- Default behavior remains single-metric to ensure no surprises.

- Rollback decision events now include quorum_evidence field in audit logs.
compatibility: Existing single-metric policies unchanged. New MultiMetricQuorum is backward compatible and opt-in. Admin APIs support both policy types.
